[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1pj[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Staged handoffs end through host completion[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Turn-ending commands (plan propose, questions, pipe, gate create, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sudo request, launch request, run, monitor start) stage their [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]handoff instead of killing the agent runner. Every root turn ends [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]normally through /sase_final, the host runs the selected finalizers[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]to their fixed point, and only then does a fixed host-owned step [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]adopt the staged handoff. Agents can commit file changes and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]propose a plan (or start a monitor) in the same turn, and no [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]handoff ever silently drops uncommitted work.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]9[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]6[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]staged_handoffs.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/staged_handoffs.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-1pj[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-1pj/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Staged-handoff foundation and plan proposals[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]plan-staging[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]plan-staging: create the staged_handoffs beta flag, the staged-handoff [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]record and its guards, the runner's post-finalizer adoption epilogue [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with fail-closed semantics, and make `sase plan propose` stage instead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of killing the runner.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Handoff descriptor and carry disposition in the finalizer wire[bold white on #D75F87][/bold #D7AFFF] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]handoff-wire[dim] · [dim][/dim]after plan-staging[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]handoff-wire: add a handoff descriptor to the sase-core finalizer [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]context, a carry repository decision legal only for same-workspace [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]handoffs, the prepared-intent rule, host-synthesized carry, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commit-finalizer support, and the revision pin move.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stage questions and pipe handoffs[/bold #D7AFFF]                             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]questions-pipe[dim] · [dim][/dim]after plan-staging, handoff-wire[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]questions-pipe: make `sase questions` and `sase pipe` stage with carry [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]allowed, adopt them through the existing runner handlers with the real [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]final response, and update their skills.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stage gate, sudo, launch, run, and workflow HITL gates[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]gate-staging[dim] · [dim][/dim]after plan-staging, handoff-wire[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate-staging: split gate-turn creation into CLI-time validate/stage and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]post-finalizer publish for every gate entry point, keeping %auto gates [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inline and moving the one-handoff guard ahead of publication.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Stage monitor starts and spawn after finalization[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]monitor-staging[dim] · [dim][/dim]after plan-staging, handoff-wire[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]monitor-staging: split monitor start into CLI-time preflight/stage and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]post-finalizer spawn, integrate prepared (-f) completion and -J joins, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and close the just-fix race between monitor checks and the commit [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]finalizer.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Idempotent adoption, crash reconciliation, and re-adopt[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]adoption-recovery[dim] · [dim][/dim]after plan-staging, questions-pipe, gate-staging, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]monitor-staging[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]adoption-recovery: make adoption idempotent for every kind, reconcile [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]staged handoffs whose runner died after finalization, and add a re-adopt[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]command for handoffs held by failed finalization.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Hold workspaces whose carried work has no successor[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]carry-hardening[dim] · [dim][/dim]after handoff-wire, questions-pipe, gate-staging, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]monitor-staging[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]carry-hardening: when carried work reaches a branch with no successor [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF](stopped or lost monitor, cancelled question, terminal gate branch, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]failed adoption), hold the workspace and surface it as stranded instead [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]of releasing it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Remove the flag and the kill-path machinery[/bold #D7AFFF]                   [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]retire-kill-path[dim] · [dim][/dim]after adoption-recovery, carry-hardening[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]retire-kill-path: delete the staged_handoffs Off branch and close its [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]flag bead, remove the runner kill and its coping code, update provider [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]protocol.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Final skills, docs, and memory[/bold #D7AFFF]                                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]docs-memory[dim] · [dim][/dim]after retire-kill-path[/#AF87FF][/dim]

    [#D7D7AF]end-of-turn protocol, review the epic land prompt, and land the decision[/#D7D7AF]
